arguments.command:
printf 'print("═ GCD & LCM CALCULATOR ═")
while True:
    line=input("Two numbers (q to quit): ")
    if line=="q":
        break
    parts=line.split()
    if len(parts)!=2 or not all(p.isdigit() for p in parts):
        print("Enter two positive integers!")
        continue
    a,b=int(parts[0]),int(parts[1])
    if a==0 or b==0:
        print("GCD: " + str(max(a,b)) + "   LCM: 0")
        continue
    x,y=a,b
    while y:
        x,y=y,x-(x//y)*y
    g=x
    print("GCD: " + str(g) + "   LCM: " + str((a*b)//g))
' > /tmp/gcd.py; python3 /tmp/gcd.py; rm -f -- /tmp/gcd.py; termy_say "Closing gcd lcm calculator" > /dev/null 2>&1
arguments.explanation: Interactive GCD and LCM calculator using the Euclidean algorithm (modulo-free subtraction form), in a loop until quit, with explicit zero handling to avoid division by zero. arguments.command:
printf 'import statistics as st
print("══ STATISTICS CALCULATOR ══")
line=input("Enter numbers separated by spaces: ")
try:
    data=[float(x) for x in line.split()]
except ValueError:
    print("Numbers only!")
    raise SystemExit
if not data:
    print("No numbers given")
else:
    print("Count:   " + str(len(data)))
    print("Sum:     " + str(round(sum(data),4)))
    print("Mean:    " + str(round(st.mean(data),4)))
    print("Median:  " + str(round(st.median(data),4)))
    if len(data)>1:
        print("Std dev: " + str(round(st.stdev(data),4)))
    print("Min:     " + str(min(data)))
    print("Max:     " + str(max(data)))
' > /tmp/stats.py && python3 /tmp/stats.py; rm -f -- /tmp/stats.py && termy_say "Closing statistics calculator" > /dev/null 2>&1
arguments.explanation: Enter numbers separated by spaces and get count, sum, mean, median, standard deviation, min and max. Protected against bad input. TCSS-compliant: printf with single-quote isolation, double-dash on rm.
arguments.goal: Compute statistics of a data set

arguments.command:
printf 'import math
print("══ GEOMETRY CALCULATOR ══")
print("1) Circle   2) Rectangle   3) Triangle   4) Sphere volume")
opt=input("Choose (1-4): ")
try:
    if opt=="1":
        r=float(input("radius: "))
        if r<0:
            print("Radius must be positive")
            raise SystemExit
        print("Area = " + str(round(math.pi*r*r,4)) + "   Perimeter = " + str(round(2*math.pi*r,4)))
    elif opt=="2":
        a=float(input("width: "))
        b=float(input("height: "))
        print("Area = " + str(round(a*b,4)) + "   Perimeter = " + str(round(2*(a+b),4)))
    elif opt=="3":
        a=float(input("base: "))
        h=float(input("height: "))
        print("Area = " + str(round(a*h/2,4)))
    elif opt=="4":
        r=float(input("radius: "))
        print("Volume = " + str(round(4/3*math.pi*r**3,4)))
    else:
        print("Invalid option")
except ValueError:
    print("Numbers only!")
' > /tmp/geo.py && python3 /tmp/geo.py; rm -f -- /tmp/geo.py && termy_say "Closing geometry calculator" > /dev/null 2>&1
